propositions: Add caused_by as a 7th link relation enum value in the schema and regenerated types, following discovered_from precedent (directional, non-blocking, non-cycle-inducing, Jira-unmapped).
The hardcoded non-blocking tuple at src/rebar/graph/_graph.py line ~204 must include caused_by to prevent incorrect blocking-cycle semantics.
Update relation string references across _links.py, unlink.py, help text, MCP writes surface, and regenerate ~8 golden CLI-help snapshots to enumerate the expanded relation set.
caused_by edges must not block task readiness or contribute to cycle detection, and two-node caused_by cycles must be permitted (non-cycle property).
Old LINK events lacking the caused_by relation must continue to reduce without error, preserving backward compatibility.
Round-trip test validates link creation, persistence, and retrieval with caused_by relation semantics.
